mapper.sql: CASE WHEN o.canceled_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN t.status='PENDING' THEN 'ASSIGNED' WHEN t.status='RUNNING' THEN 'IN_TRANSIT' WHEN t.status='COMPLETED' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'WAITING_DISPATCH' END
FROM transport_order o LEFT JOIN transport_task t ON t.id=o.current_task_id AND t.transport_order_id=o.id AND t.status<>'CANCELED'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM transport_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE transport_order SET fleet_id=#{draft.fleetId},task_type=#{draft.taskType},description=#{draft.description}, origin_address=#{draft.originAddress},destination_address=#{draft.destinationAddress}, starts_at=#{draft.startsAt},ends_at=#{draft.endsAt},requirement=#{draft.requirement}, version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE transport_order SET current_task_id=#{taskId},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE transport_order SET canceled_at=#{at},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS task_id,driver_id,vehicle_id,dispatch_order_version AS expected_version FROM transport_task WHERE transport_order_id=#{orderId} AND order_dispatch_key=#{requestKey}

SELECT u.id AS driver_id,u.name AS driver_name,v.id AS vehicle_id,v.plate_no, CASE WHEN f.enabled=0 OR u.enabled=0 OR v.id IS NULL OR #{order.endsAt}<=#{at} OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift s JOIN driver_attendance a ON a.shift_id=s.id WHERE s.driver_id=u.id AND s.starts_at<=#{at} AND s.ends_at>#{at} AND a.clock_out_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driver_shift r WHERE r.driver_id=u.id AND r.shift_type='REST' AND (r.shift_date=DATE(#{at}) OR (r.shift_date>=DATE(#{order.startsAt}) AND CAST(r.shift_date AS DATETIME)<#{order.endsAt}))) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driver_leave l WHERE l.driver_id=u.id AND l.status='APPROVED' AND ((l.starts_at<=#{at} AND l.ends_at>#{at}) OR (l.starts_at<#{order.endsAt} AND l.ends_at>#{order.startsAt}))) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM transport_task t WHERE (t.driver_id=u.id OR t.vehicle_id=v.id) AND (t.status='RUNNING' OR (t.status='PENDING' AND t.starts_at<#{order.endsAt} AND t.ends_at>#{order.startsAt}))) THEN 'DRIVER_NOT_ELIGIBLE' WHEN #{order.requirement}='HIGH' AND r.batch_id IS NULL THEN 'RATING_UNAVAILABLE' WHEN #{order.requirement}='HIGH' AND r.level NOT IN #{level} THEN 'RATING_BELOW_REQUIREMENT' ELSE NULL END AS unavailable_reason, r.batch_id,r.score,r.level,b.data_as_of,b.published_at,r.has_driving_history FROM sys_user u JOIN fleet f ON f.id=u.fleet_id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON v.id=u.vehicle_id AND v.fleet_id=u.fleet_id LEFT JOIN driver_safety_rating_control c ON c.id=1 LEFT JOIN driver_safety_rating_batch b ON b.id=c.published_batch_id AND b.status='PUBLISHED' LEFT JOIN driver_safety_rating_result r ON r.batch_id=b.id AND r.driver_id=u.id WHERE u.role='DRIVER' AND u.fleet_id=#{order.fleetId} ORDER BY unavailable_reason IS NOT NULL,driver_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role='DRIVER' AND fleet_id=#{fleetId}
